experimental_method: Synthetic visual method in a horizontal Hastelloy C276 cell with sapphire window and piston: known masses of water (or brine) and CO2 are loaded, pressure raised until the last bubble disappears (bubble-point pressure).
uncertainties_stated: u(T)=0.15 K, u(x)=0.0002, u(p)=0.004 MPa, u(m)=0.005 mol/kg; transducer accuracy better than 0.2% (calibrated per EN 837-1)
quality_remarks: Authors compare with 21 literature sources (AAD 0.11 MPa, 8.46%) for pure water. Temperature scale not stated. Journal footnote text 'mol kg1' is a lost superscript (mol kg-1).

not_extracted_tables.reason: Henry's constants H_CO2,L/MPa estimated by fitting the RKSA-Infochem + electrolyte EoS to the measured data (derived, model-based)
